actions.action: Repot into a pot 2-5 cm wider with drainage holes (in spring/early summer)
Use regular potting soil mixed with about a third perlite or pumice
Inspect roots, trim black/mushy roots and loosen circling roots
Check top 2-3 cm of soil is dry before watering again
Keep out of direct harsh sun for 1-2 weeks after repotting
Alternative if can't repot: top up with fresh mix keeping soil below root flare

reason: The answer identifies a rootbound plant in thin old soil, makes repotting the main fix, and rightly warns against piling soil on top, matching the thread; nothing in it is harmful.
